Core Skills & Technical Competencies
3D CAD Modeling (SolidWorks), GD&T; (ASME Y14.5), ANSYS FEA Thermal & Stress Analysis, Design for Manufacturing

Education

Licensed Professional Engineer (PE #ME-9821), SolidWorks CSWE Certified

Led patent-pending cooling plate design reducing thermal throttling by 30%.
